title: Unique Friend | LibAI Lab Co-founder: PromeAI Brings Creative Ideas into Reality

html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · October 14, 2024 · Guest: Co-founder, LibAI Lab · Product: PromeAI (神采)

Product advantages: Simple UX, fast generation, beginner-friendly “same-style” one-click; works on phone or PC (browser URL — no high-end GPU box); no VPN needed — strong Chinese semantic understanding; affordable membership for individuals and teams with multi-account sync; train consistent style models; batch ~10 variants per run. Scenes: e-commerce, interior, architecture, games/anime, fashion. Enterprise landing focus — every feature aimed at real cost/efficiency gains.

GenAI impact: AI assists; humans still decide. Goal: help more firms cut cost while shipping high-quality promo and product design.

Tech lead: Build from customer pain; use tech moats to maximize useful features; keep exploring new algorithms.

Ecosystem: Model vendors train/optimize; up/downstream share resources, complement tech, co-expand markets. Playbook: mutual trust, clear shared goals, regular communication, deepen R&D/GTM/supply collab, invent joint R&D/production/sales modes.

Challenges / market: Fierce domestic competition; weaker paid mindset than overseas; entertainment AI tools win mass attention.

— END —
